_how_to_edit: Usual developer resale rule before handover: re = % of the price that must be paid before the developer gives the NOC to resell; noc = developer NOC / transfer fee in AED. Keys are brand names in lower case (as in the page's developer groups). Figures are typical policies reported by the market or set by Sam; the buyer's own SPA always wins. 'src' is shown to the buyer.

_default.src: typical Dubai developer policy (most ask for 30–40% paid; NOC around AED 5,000)

emaar.src: Emaar usually 50% paid; NOC about AED 1,000 (AED 2,000 express)

nakheel.src: Nakheel usually 40% paid; NOC about AED 500

damac.src: DAMAC usually 30–35% paid; NOC around AED 5,000

sobha.src: Sobha usually 40% paid; NOC up to about AED 5,250

dubai holding.src: Dubai Holding (Nakheel / Meraas / DP) projects: usually 30–40% paid
